title: The crosscutting concepts at a glance

cards.title: The rules every part follows
cards.text: What holds in core, every pack and every host, whichever part you change.

cards.title: Security
cards.text: Secrets stay out, paths stay in the workspace, arguments are data, fetches stay public, hosts fail closed.

cards.title: Messages
cards.text: Every text is an enum member with a template; what the model reads is pinned by a golden file.

cards.title: Logging and tracing
cards.text: ILogger to stderr and a run file, two records, the usage ledger, and OpenTelemetry when asked.

cards.title: Testing
cards.text: Tests first, with NUnit; unit tests stay in their process, integration tests in their own projects.

cards.title: Configuration
cards.text: Settings in config/.env, secrets apart, the model's in a profile, choices as enums.
